title: The Compass Lie

script.text: The easternmost point of the United States is in Alaska.

script: Follow the Aleutian Islands west, and they cross the [180°|one hundred eightieth] meridian.
On the far side of that line, west becomes east.
Semisopochnoi Island, in Alaska, sits in the Eastern Hemisphere.
That makes Alaska the northernmost state, the westernmost, and the easternmost.
Your mental map lies in other places too.
Reno, Nevada, is west of Los Angeles.
Santiago, Chile, is east of New York.
And sail the Panama Canal from the Atlantic to the Pacific.

script.text: You finish about [40|forty] kilometers east of where you started.

script: So next time someone says Maine is the easternmost state, point them west. Very far west.
